name: Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands placed on your hips or clasped lightly in front of your chest.
Step forward and bend both knees until your back knee approaches the floor and your front foot stays planted.
Drive firmly through your front foot to stand upright and immediately step your trailing leg forward into the next lunge.
Continue walking forward while alternating legs with each step in a controlled, steady rhythm.
tips: Step wide enough side to side to maintain sturdy balance rather than walking on a single narrow line.
Keep your chest upright and prevent your front knee from diving inward.
